name: io.github.markusvankempen/mcp-ticket-demo
description: MCP server demo — tickets, schema discovery, auth, and PII gating. stdio + HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Use 'stdio' for IDE child process, 'http' for HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for authenticated tool calls. Issue one on /admin → API Keys. Required when AUTH_MODE=write or AUTH_MODE=all.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode: off (default), write (write+pii tools gated), all (every tool gated).

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Listen port. Default 8080 (8787 in npm run http).

environmentVariables.name: HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address. Default 127.0.0.1 on a laptop; 0.0.0.0 in a container.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for authenticated tool calls. Required when AUTH_MODE=write or AUTH_MODE=all.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode: off (default), write, or all.

environmentVariables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Required on a public bind. Laptop default demo/demo is disabled when HOST=0.0.0.0 or in a container.

environmentVariables.name: CORS_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated extra Origin values allowed on /mcp. Localhost and same-host are always allowed.
